title: Rezoning map change for 9305 Fifth Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This application would change zoning map designations at 9305 Fifth Avenue in Bay Ridge, Brooklyn, from R6B/C2-3 and R5B districts to an R7X/R7D district with a C2-4 overlay. The change would help allow an 11-story mixed-use building with 292 apartments, about 88 of them income-restricted, plus commercial and community facility space. The Council approved the change with modifications on October 8, 2026.
